scripts.build: npm run frontend:build && uv run pywrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler-dist
scripts.check: uv run ruff check src tests && uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests && npm run frontend:lint && npm run build
scripts.deploy: npm run frontend:build && uv run pywrangler deploy
scripts.dev: npm run frontend:build && uv run pywrangler dev
scripts.test: uv run python -m unittest discover -s tests
